title: Regional Admin Manager- Hyd
description:
* Job Purpose:

The Lead – Admin – Gold Loan Business is responsible for overseeing branch-level administrative operations across zonal networks, ensuring smooth functioning, compliance, infrastructure readiness, and cost control. The role manages contract staff, coordinates with cross-functional stakeholders, and ensures operational continuity to support business growth and governance.
  
  

* Dimensions:

Branch Operations
  
  
Supervise administrative activities across multiple zonal branches .
  
  
Facility Management
  
  
Ensure preventive maintenance, asset management, and vendor coordination.
  
  
Branch Expansion
  
  
Lead infrastructure development, site readiness, and project execution
  
  
Compliance
  
  
Ensure adherence to statutory requirements and internal audit standards .
  
  
Financial Control
  
  
Manage administrative budgets, vendor payments, and expense tracking
  
  
Team Management
  
  
Supervise contract staff and ensure productivity.
  
  

* Job Context & Major Challenges:

**Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non-Deposit accepting Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.
  
  
ABCL offers end-to-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers - Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid & Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health & Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.
  
  
ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII.
  
  
**Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management.
  
  
**Job Context**
Gold Loans are a high-volume, sensitive product requiring strong operational governance. The Lead – Admin role ensures seamless branch operations, infrastructure readiness, and compliance while balancing cost efficiency and service quality.
  
  
**Key Challenges**

* Managing large-scale branch networks with diverse operational needs.
* Ensuring timely completion of infrastructure projects without disrupting business.
* Maintaining compliance with state and central statutory requirements.
* Driving cost control while ensuring service quality.
* Coordinating across multiple stakeholders and vendors.

**Key Result Areas**
Supporting Actions
  
  
Branch Operations & Facility Management
  
  
Oversee daily administrative operations, manage housekeeping/security, resolve branch issues, supervise preventive maintenance, and implement asset management systems.
  
  
Branch Expansion & Infrastructure Development
  
  
Lead new branch setup, coordinate civil/interior projects, manage vendor onboarding, and ensure timely project completion.
  
  
Compliance, Reporting & Risk Management
  
  
Ensure statutory compliance, maintain registers, prepare MIS reports, address audit queries, and manage asset lifecycle.
  
  
Travel, Logistics & Stakeholder Coordination
  
  
Manage travel desk, organize events/meetings, oversee courier operations, and coordinate with cross-functional teams.

title: Lead OE Ops
description:
**Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.**
is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
**Good Health Can’t Wait.**

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

"

**Job Description**

Job Summary

This role is for a Continuous Improvement (CI) Manager responsible for driving site-wide operational excellence through structured problem-solving, Lean methodologies, and cultural transformation. The position requires a hands-on leader with expertise in Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and performance analytics. As a key driver of productivity and efficiency, this role will establish a multi-year CI roadmap, lead high-impact improvement projects, and support cross-functional teams in identifying and resolving systemic issues.

1. **Responsibilities:**
   1. Ensure compliance with cGMP, EHS, data integrity, and all regulatory requirements.
   2. Implement company policies, systems, and procedures effectively while ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and strategic goals.
   3. Maintain discipline, safety standards, and adherence to SOPs on the shop floor.
   4. Lead OE diagnostic session to identify ideas to improve OPEX, TVC.
   5. Facilitate LMS (Lean Management System) idea generation, evaluation, implementation, and sustainability.
   6. Conduct plant capacity analysis and develop improvement plans to maintain a minimum 1.3X flexible manufacturing capacity.
   7. Monitor Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), identify major losses, and drive improvement projects to enhance equipment performance.
   8. Monitor and optimize Productivity metrics & improve it to reach TD.
   9. Establish annual SDP KPI baselines, set targets, and drive action plans to achieve business objectives.
   10. Track Requirement vs Capacity vs Actual (R vs C vs A) performance, analyze gaps, and implement corrective actions to improve manufacturing efficiency.
   11. Identify process bottlenecks and implement solutions to reduce Door-to-Ship (D2S) lead time for critical products.
   12. Drive Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Kaizen, Lean projects, and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.
   13. Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Quality, Warehouse, Planning, and Supply Chain teams to achieve plant performance objectives.
   14. Lead automation, digitalization, and process improvement projects to enhance operational efficiency and reliability.
   15. Support production planning and prioritization to maximize throughput and minimize delays.
   16. Lead TPM deployment across manufacturing and engineering functions in alignment with corporate TPM roadmap.
   17. Implement and sustain Autonomous Maintenance (Jishu Hozen) pillars, driving progression through TPM maturity levels and achieving targeted JH steps.
   18. Strengthen Planned Maintenance systems through preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance practices.
   19. Drive initiatives to achieve Zero Breakdown, Zero Defect, Zero Accident, and Zero Waste objectives.
   20. Develop and monitor equipment health indicators, maintenance KPIs, and asset robustness metrics.
   21. Facilitate Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, CAPA, and reliability improvement programs for critical equipment.
   22. Build operator and maintenance team capability through TPM training, coaching, and competency development programs.

"

**Qualifications**

Educational Qualification

Graduation in Mechanical, Industrial, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy or related field is mandatory.
  
  
Certification in Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt) and Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt) is preferred.
  
  
JIPM certification is preferred.

Minimum Work Experience

10+ years of experience

Skills & Attributes Functional Skills

* Best Practice Implementation
* Failure Mode And Effects Analysis
* Overall Equipment Effectiveness
* Process Analysis
* Process Mapping
* Project Management
* Statistics

Resident Skills

* Continuous Improvement Process
* Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs)
* Lean Methodologies
* Operational Excellence

Behavioural Skills

* **Proactive Leadership**
  – Takes initiative to identify improvement areas and mobilize cross-functional teams toward impactful solutions.
* **Collaboration & Coaching**
  – Builds trust and engagement across teams by mentoring, facilitating workshops, and encouraging shared ownership of outcomes.
* **Results Orientation**
  – Maintains a sharp focus on measurable outcomes, driving projects with discipline and accountability to deliver operational excellence.

Critical Exposures

* Experience in Lean Six Sigma project execution, process audits and compliance with operational and quality standards is desired.
* Exposure to data analysis and reporting in transformation projects to track process performance, quality improvements, and change management is preferred.
* Experience in FMEA and Root Cause Analysis to optimize costs and productivity is desired.
* Exposure to Lean tools such as Kaizen, VSM, or SMED for throughput improvement, changeover time reduction, and labour/material optimization is preferred.

"

**Additional Information**

Benefits Offered

At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

" Our Work Culture

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/"

title: Global Lead Fin OPS Technology Operations
description:
**Position Purpose**
The Associate Director, FinOps is accountable for establishing, scaling, and leading the enterprise FinOps practice across both cloud and on-premises technology estates, embedding financial accountability, cost transparency, and value optimization into how technology is consumed, designed, and governed. Acting as the senior bridge between Finance, Platform, and Application teams, the role drives cost visibility through show back and chargeback, owns spend governance, unlocks savings through commitment and optimization strategies, defines cost-aware design guidelines, and partners closely with cloud and infrastructure vendors to bring new cost-saving strategies, stronger governance, and improved cost visibility — while cultivating a durable culture of cost awareness and accountability across the organization.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Your responsibilities include, but not limited to**

* Cost Visibility, Reporting & Transparency: Build and own enterprise cost visibility across cloud and on-premises estates, delivering accurate, timely, and decision-ready reporting to Finance, Platform, and Application teams. Design and operate show back models and define chargeback frameworks that fairly and transparently allocate technology cost to business units, products, and services. Establish FinOps KPIs, dashboards, and unit-economics metrics that connect technology spend to business value and consumption.
* Spend Governance & Financial Accountability: Define, implement, and enforce spend governance policies, budgets, thresholds, tagging standards, and approval guardrails across the technology estate. Lead budgeting, forecasting, and variance management, proactively identifying cost anomalies, drift, and untagged or unaccountable spend. Drive financial accountability by ensuring every cost has a clear owner, allocation, and justification.
* Savings Enablement & Commitment Management: Enable savings through commitment-based approaches such as reserved instances, savings plans, committed-use discounts, and enterprise agreements, balancing flexibility against discount depth. Build and manage the commitment portfolio end to end, optimizing coverage, utilization, and renewal strategy to maximize realized savings. Structure rate, discount, and commercial savings strategies in partnership with vendors and procurement.
* Optimization & Efficiency: Run continuous optimization across cloud and on-premises — rightsizing, waste elimination, idle-resource reclamation, storage tiering, and utilization improvement. Establish optimization backlogs, savings targets, and realization tracking, holding platform and application teams accountable for execution. Quantify, validate, and report realized versus potential savings to leadership with clear evidence and trends.
* Cost-Aware Design Guidelines & Architecture: Create cost-aware design guidelines, reference patterns, and architectural standards that embed efficiency from the point of design. Partner with architecture and platform teams to make cost a first-class design constraint alongside performance, resilience, and security. Review major designs and changes for cost impact before they are built, preventing avoidable spend at the source.
* On-Premises FinOps & Lifecycle Management: Extend FinOps discipline beyond cloud to the on-premises estate, covering data centers, compute, storage, networking, and software licensing. Manage infrastructure and asset lifecycle — capacity planning, refresh cycles, depreciation, decommissioning, and total cost of ownership. Drive consistent cost visibility, allocation, and governance across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
* Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the trusted FinOps partner to Finance, Platform teams, and Application teams, translating fluently between financial and technical perspectives. Align stakeholders around shared cost objectives, allocation models, and accountability frameworks. Influence and drive adoption of FinOps practices across decentralized engineering and business teams.
* Vendor & Partner Cost Strategy: Work closely with cloud and infrastructure vendors to bring new cost-saving strategies, pricing constructs, and emerging capabilities to the organization. Partner with vendors to improve governance, strengthen cost visibility, and unlock commercial and technical efficiency. Benchmark vendor commercial models and leverage strategic relationships to continuously improve value.
* Cost Awareness & FinOps Culture: Build and embed a culture of cost awareness and accountability across technology and business teams. Deliver enablement, training, and communication that turn engineers and stakeholders into cost-conscious decisionmakers. Champion the FinOps operating model, maturing its capabilities, processes, and tooling over time.

**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**

* 10–12+ years of experience in FinOps, IT financial management, technology cost optimization, or cloud and infrastructure financial governance, including time in a senior or lead capacity.
* FinOps Practice Leadership: Proven track record establishing, scaling, or leading an enterprise FinOps practice across both cloud and on-premises environments.
* Cloud & On-Premises Cost Management: Deep, hands-on understanding of cost management across hyperscale cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises data center, licensing, and infrastructure lifecycle economics.
* Commitment & Savings Strategy: Demonstrated expertise in commitment-based savings (reserved instances, savings plans, committed-use discounts), rate optimization, and realized-savings management.
* Governance, Reporting & Financial Acumen: Strong command of show back and chargeback, budgeting, forecasting, unit economics, and spend governance, with the ability to connect cost to business value.
* Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Advanced ability to partner across Finance, Platform, and Application teams and to work with cloud and infrastructure vendors to drive new cost and governance strategies.
* Influence & Cost Culture: Proven ability to build cost awareness and accountability, driving change through influence across decentralized technical and business teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related discipline; master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MSc in Finance or Technology Management) strongly preferred.
* FinOps Certified Practitioner or Professional, cloud cost or cloud architecture certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP), IT asset management / ITIL certifications are a plus.
* Why Sandoz?

Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of good health.
  
  
With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.
  
  
Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
  
  
Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
  
  
**Commitment To Diversity & Inclusion**
We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
  
  
#Sandoz

title: Security Manager
description:
**Job Description - Security Manager**
**Employer:**
G4S Secure Solutions India Pvt. Ltd.
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent
  
  
**Payroll:**
G4S Secure Solutions India Pvt. Ltd.
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Regional Security Head / Client Security Leadership
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a
**seasoned and strategic Security Manager**
to lead physical security operations across key client locations in South India. The role requires a proven leader with strong operational acumen, crisis management skills, and the ability to align security programs with business continuity objectives. The successful candidate must demonstrate
**fluent communication skills, leadership presence, and a strategic mindset**
to manage high-profile client environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct risk assessments and introduce preventive measures to strengthen security posture.
* Drive alignment between client requirements and G4S service delivery standards.

* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Knowledge of access control, CCTV, alarms, and emergency communication systems.
* High integrity, discipline, and ability to make decisions under pressure.

* Starting at ₹12 LPA CTC and negotiable depending on candidate performance during interview.

**Why Join G4S Secure Solutions?**

* Be part of the world’s leading integrated security solutions provider.
* Opportunity to manage high-value client portfolios across South India.
* Professional growth and exposure to international standards in security and risk management.

title: Manager II, Tech(AI)
description:
**Overview**
 BEST is modernizing our data capabilities to accelerate product innovation, data\-driven decision making, and AI\-enabled experiences. Today the organization operates with traditional data engineering practices; we are hiring a transformation leader who will modernize the platform, build production\-grade ML/AI capabilities, and embed responsible AI across the business.
   

  

 We’re hiring a strategic, hands\-on
 **Sr. Manager, Data Services** 
 to own and scale BEST’s data platform and teams—leading engineers and managers across ingestion, transformation, platform services, data products/APIs, governance, and production ML/AI. You’ll be accountable for MLOps, model serving, and the people/processes to safely operationalize AI at scale, transforming a traditional data\-engineering function into an AI\-first, product\-oriented organization. This role requires deep technical expertise in data platforms, MLOps and LLM/AI patterns, plus proven people leadership and cross\-functional influence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Strategy \& Roadmap — Define and operationalize a 12–24 month roadmap for Data Services that supports company data and AI goals (data APIs, platform, governance, ML pipelines, model serving and monitoring).
* Team Leadership — Hire, mentor and grow a high\-performing team (data engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, SREs). Build leadership bench and establish clear career paths.
* Data Platform Ownership — Own the design, delivery, and run\-book for data platforms (data lake/warehouse, streaming, ingestion, processing, metadata/catalog, lineage and observability).
* ML/AI Enablement — Partner with AI/ML teams to build repeatable ML pipelines and production model serving (batch \& real\-time). Lead MLOps adoption: model training, deployment, CI/CD, drift detection, and model governance.
* AI Productionization — Drive production\-grade implementations of AI use\-cases (including large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, agentic/automated workflows). Ensure safe, scalable, and cost\-efficient model serving and inference.
* Data Products \& APIs — Deliver production data products and APIs consumed by analytics, product teams, and AI systems. Enable self\-service data and ML capabilities for downstream teams.
* Quality, Observability \& Governance — Implement enterprise\-grade data quality, lineage, cataloging, access controls, and privacy/compliance practices. Partner with security and legal on policy for AI model usage and data privacy.
* Stakeholder Management — Work cross\-functionally with product, engineering, marketing, sales, and COE to translate business needs into data and AI programs, prioritizing high\-impact work and measuring outcomes.
* Metrics \& Outcomes — Define and report KPIs for platform reliability, time\-to\-insight, model accuracy/performance, cost, and adoption.


**Qualifications**
* 12\+ years’ experience in data engineering, data platform, analytics, or ML engineering roles, with at least 3\+ years in a people\-/team\-management role.
* Hands\-on experience building and operating large\-scale data platforms (data lakes/warehouses, Spark/Databricks, Snowflake/Redshift/BigQuery, streaming with Kafka/Kinesis).
* Demonstrated track record of taking ML/AI projects from POC to production. Practical experience with MLOps tooling and pipelines (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or equivalent).
* Deep familiarity with model serving and inference architectures (real\-time and batch), model monitoring, automated retraining, and drift detection.
* Strong engineering skills: Python / SQL (and/or Scala/Java), data pipeline frameworks, and versioned data/model workflows.
* Experience with LLMs and modern AI application patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, LLM safety/guardrails, and LLMOps frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Cloud platform experience (AWS / Azure / GCP) and experience designing cost\-efficient, production\-grade ML inference at scale.
* Experience with data governance, cataloging (Amundsen/Atlas/Data Catalog), lineage and privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA) in a production environment.
* Excellent people and cross\-functional leadership skills, with strong communication, stakeholder influence, and program management ability.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field. Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in a quantitative or engineering discipline preferred.

title: Network Operations Center - Shift Lead
description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The NOC Shift Lead is responsible for leading a team of Network Engineers during a designated shift, managing Major Incidents, ensuring the smooth operation, monitoring, and maintenance of the organization's computer networks. This role involves both technical expertise and leadership skills.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 At Zelis, Network Operating Center (NOC) Shift Lead is a leadership role within the NOC responsible for overseeing the activities of a team of engineers during a specific shift. This role requires a combination of technical expertise in network operations, leadership skills, Incident Management and the ability to manage and respond to network incidents.
   

  

 The NOC Shift Lead is responsible for leading a team of Network Engineers during a designated shift, managing Major Incidents, ensuring the smooth operation, monitoring, and maintenance of the organization's computer networks. This role involves both technical expertise and leadership skills.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Working in 24/7 Operational support.
* Monitor network, server, and health infrastructure using tools like LogicMonitor, New relic.
* Network Service \& Protocols (DHCP, DNS, NTP, VPN \& Tunneling, QoS, Common Protocols)
* Good experience in Firewalls, IDS/IPS and Authentication, configuration \& troubleshooting of Router, Firewalls (Palo Alto), VPNs \& Switch, troubleshooting tools (ping, traceroute, netstat, Wireshark) and Access control.
* Respond to alerts and incidents, perform initial troubleshooting, and escalate as needed.
* Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) for issue resolution and escalation.
* Assist in routine maintenance tasks such as patching, backups, and system checks.
* Windows Server Administration and troubleshooting.
* Perception of analyzing the workflow, issue or the cause of the problem.
* Manages firewalls, IDS/IPS, and endpoint protection systems is an added advantage.
* Mentors junior staff and enforces security best practices.
* Able to perform the Firewall, WLC, Switch and Meraki upgrades.
* Lead Incident Management activities, ensuring timely resolution and communication.
* Initiate bridge calls or war rooms to drive communication among stakeholders for timely incident resolution.
* Plan and coordinate the activities of the NOC team during the shift.
* Assign tasks and responsibilities to team members.
* Act as the point of contact for major incidents during the shift.
* Communicate effectively with management and other teams during incidents.
* Monitor network performance and respond to alerts as needed.
* Analyze incidents, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure that network issues are resolved within established SLAs.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, resolutions, and activities during the shift.
* Generate shift reports and provide updates to management and relevant stakeholders.
* Provide ongoing training to NOC Engineers to enhance their technical skills.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the team.
* Collaborate with other NOC Shift Leads and teams to address cross\-functional issues.
* Participate in regular meetings to share insights and updates.
* Collaborate with Network Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, Application Support, Service Management, and vendor teams, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on service availability and reducing MTTD, MTTA, and MTTR.
* Ensure compliance with security protocols and procedures.


**Qualifications**
* 5\-6 years of experience in relevant domain NOC
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Associate CCNA or CCNP
* Proven experience in network administration and incident response.
* Previous leadership or supervisory experience.
* Practical understanding of ITIL\-based Incident, Change, Problem, and Major Incident Management processes.


**Skills**
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent communication and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to handle high\-pressure situations and make informed decisions.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, log\-analysis, and ITSM platforms such as Splunk, Datadog, LogicMonitor, Jira Service Management, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong incident troubleshooting, prioritization, escalation, service restoration, alert correlation, and RCA support skills.
* Ability to communicate concise incident updates covering impact, actions taken, findings, ownership, next steps, and outstanding risks to both technical and operational stakeholders.
* Strong written documentation and knowledge\-transfer skills, including incident notes, shift handovers, SOPs, runbooks, Knowledge Base articles, and troubleshooting guides.
* Ability to identify opportunities for operational automation and continuous improvement, with strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and customer\-service skills.


 This role requires strong technical and operational skills, with the ability to independently monitor, triage, troubleshoot, escalate, document, and support restoration of network, server, infrastructure, and application incidents during assigned shifts.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Financial Inclusion District Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vedavaag Systems Ltd is a technology\-driven company headquartered in India, focusing on innovative solutions that support governance, financial services, and inclusive growth. The organization works closely with public and private sector partners to extend essential services to underserved and rural communities. Vedavaag Systems Ltd emphasizes operational efficiency, customer\-centric service delivery, and sustainable models that promote financial inclusion. The company offers opportunities for professionals interested in social impact, technology\-enabled service delivery, and expanding access to financial services across diverse regions in India.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Financial Inclusion District Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Telangana, India. This role oversees district\-level financial inclusion initiatives, including planning, implementing, and monitoring programs that extend banking and financial services to underserved communities. The person in this role will manage field teams, coordinate with partner banks and agencies, track performance against outreach and service targets, and ensure compliance with relevant policies and guidelines. Daily responsibilities include reviewing operational reports, resolving escalated issues, conducting site visits, facilitating community engagement activities, and ensuring quality customer service and data accuracy. The District Manager will also promote inclusive practices, support training and capacity building for staff, and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and service delivery.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong Program Management and Project Management skills to plan, execute, and monitor district\-level financial inclusion initiatives.
* Experience in Diversity \& Inclusion and Employee Engagement to foster an inclusive, motivated, and high\-performing field workforce.
* Excellent Communication skills, including the ability to collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and community stakeholders.
* Background in banking, financial services, or financial inclusion programs is highly beneficial.
* Ability to analyze data, prepare performance reports, and use insights to drive improvements in outreach and service quality.
* Proven people\-management experience, including supervising field teams and conducting training and performance evaluations.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, social sciences, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Comfort working on\-site across district locations in Telangana and willingness to travel within the assigned region as needed.

title: Regional Launch Director SIR
description:
**Job Description Summary**
* Job Description


 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the
   

  

 launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional
   

  

 collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional
   

  

 launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing
   

  

 mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the
   

  

 short and long term. Commercial launch readiness is achieved through close
   

  

 collaboration with Commercial teams in market, and with close collaboration and
   

  

 support from Platforms, Development, BD, Regulatory, IP/Legal, STO and ESO.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Purpose:**
 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the short and long term. Commercial launch readiness is achieved through close collaboration with Commercial teams in market, and with close collaboration and support from Platforms, Development, BD, Regulatory, IP/Legal, STO and ESO.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Proactively lead the development and implementation of strategic regional launch readiness.
* Monitor the launch performance, competitive environment to quickly identify plan changes.
* Manage ROI assessments of tactical programs \& through collaboration with Commercial Leadership, develop and execute action plans to address competitive threats and/ or exogenous market events, maximizing pipeline value.
* Engage with other functional teams to ensure operational launch readiness of Region SIR launches and ensure E2E coordination to maximize commercial opportunities.
* Collaborate with Platforms on critical issues related to market commercialization, aligning as appropriate to their global product launch strategy.
* Together with Supply Chain and Platforms, drive decisions for regional product allocations if needed, at\-risk manufacturing and API purchases to optimize upsides and mitigate risk.
* Provide leadership to the market team and extended functional launch team members including coaching, advising, and developing team members
* Ensure compliance with Sandoz policies and procedures and full integration into the Sandoz culture and support resources
* Perform other duties as required by the Region from time to time.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* A minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience in the GLP\-1 or Biosimilar field
* Sales/commercial leadership and mindset
* Sound Project Management experience (min 5 years)
* Hands\-on approach combined with business acumen, strategic thinking, and pragmatism
* Experience in managing/leading cross\-functional matrix teams
* Excellent communication and relationship management skills
* Stakeholder engagement with respect for different cultures and diverse groups.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human rightof access to good healthcare.
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
   

  

**Skills Desired**
 Agility, Brand Awareness, Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Customer Engagement, Customer Experience, Customer Insights, Data Strategy, Digital Marketing, Go\-To\-Market Strategy, Influencing Skills, Inspirational Leadership, Marketing Strategy, Media Campaigns, People Management, Product Marketing, Product Roadmap, Return on Investment (ROI), Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Marketing

title: Manager, Clinical Operations
description:
**Description**
 Manager, Clinical Operations
   

  

 Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
   

  

 Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
   

  

 Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full\-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
   

  

 Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
   

  

 Why Syneos Health
   

  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.


**Job Responsibilities**
 Job Summary
   

  

 Accountable for and provides management support and direct supervision to Clinical Operations staff in the assigned areas including Site Selection support, site contracts support, regulatory/ethics submissions, site activities including site activation as well as On\-Site Monitoring and/or Central Monitoring through Study Close Out. Provides training, consultation and oversees metric compliance and quality related to operating activities of assigned staff to ensure project deliverables are met. Collaborates and oversees Clinical Operations Team to ensure fulfillment of customer requirements and compliance with related regulations. Supports senior management in operational level planning. May participate in business development presentations as a subject matter expert in Clinical Operations functions within the Company.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Line management of Clinical Operations staff, responsibilities including interviewing and selection, termination, professional development, performance appraisals, and employee counselling May be involved in assignment of project work and will review workloads for all direct reports. Manages staff by establishing goals that will increase knowledge and skill levels, and by delegating tasks commensurate with skill level.
* Review workload for all staff in reporting chain, participate in managing the resource availability for the assigned staff, providing support that projects are suitably resourced and staffing needs are identified in a timely fashion.
* Provide expert operational oversight and guidance to support prioritization of activities, review and monitor the work performed, metric compliance, and development of contingency plans, among others.
* Assist in recruiting new staff, including participation in interview process and new hire on boarding. Proactively work to ensure staff retention and turnover rates remain within expected levels.
* Ensure quality and adherence to Standard Operating Procedures/Work Instructions (SOP/WIs) and compliance with federal and local guidelines and ICH GCP. Ensure all staff follow required training and complete required documentation. Provide regular updates to management accordingly.
* Work closely within appropriate business unit/region to ensure staff performance on studies and correct deficiencies as identified by staff, customers, and auditors. Able to contribute to BU level process improvements. May provide business development support.
* May conduct several types of sign off and assessment visits to ensure Clinical Operations on\-site performance. Develop and oversee training plans to address performance deficiencies. Ensure staff adhere to training guidelines, training records maintenance, and individual and corporate training needs are identified and addressed.
* Organize and chair clinical staff meetings at regular intervals. Manage issues and provide follow up for action items requiring resolution.
* Facilitate and support project and team/country reviews with Clinical Operations staff, focusing on budget, schedule, and risk analysis. Use department systems, reports, and dashboards to identify performance issues, process gaps and monitor overall performance progress in line with departmental goals and metric targets. Oversee all quality control efforts of assigned teams.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, nursing degree, or equivalent related experience, plus extensive clinical research experience in a contract research organization, pharmaceutical or Biotechnology Company, including some time in a leadership capacity or equivalent combination of education, training and experience is required.
* Preference to have experience in the industry, managing clinical portfolios, and in clinical operations.
* Strong experience in Regulatory \& Startup process.
* People management experience in managing 15\-16 direct reports.
* Extensive knowledge of GCP/ICH guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
* Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal, and change management skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince, and persuade.
* Strong time management, technical and organizational skills. Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
* Knowledge of basic financial concepts as related to forecasting and budgeting. Understands project budgets.
* Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace modern technologies.
* Ability to travel as necessary (up to 25%)


**Get to know Syneos Health**
 Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.
   

  

 No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
   

  

 http://www.syneoshealth.com
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
   

  

**Summary**
 Accountable for and provides management support and direct supervision to Clinical Operations staff in the assigned areas including Site Selection support, site contracts support, regulatory/ethics submissions, site activities including site activation as well as On\-Site Monitoring and/or Central Monitoring through Study Close Out. Provides training, consultation and oversees metric compliance and quality related to operating activities of assigned staff to ensure project deliverables are met. Collaborates and oversees Clinical Operations Team to ensure fulfillment of customer requirements and compliance with related regulations. Supports senior management in operational level planning. May participate in business development presentations as a subject matter expert in Clinical Operations functions within the Company.

title: Manager II, Tech(AI)
description:
**Overview**
 BEST is modernizing our data capabilities to accelerate product innovation, data\-driven decision making, and AI\-enabled experiences. Today the organization operates with traditional data engineering practices; we are hiring a transformation leader who will modernize the platform, build production\-grade ML/AI capabilities, and embed responsible AI across the business.
   

  

 We’re hiring a strategic, hands\-on
 **Sr. Manager, Data Services** 
 to own and scale BEST’s data platform and teams—leading engineers and managers across ingestion, transformation, platform services, data products/APIs, governance, and production ML/AI. You’ll be accountable for MLOps, model serving, and the people/processes to safely operationalize AI at scale, transforming a traditional data\-engineering function into an AI\-first, product\-oriented organization. This role requires deep technical expertise in data platforms, MLOps and LLM/AI patterns, plus proven people leadership and cross\-functional influence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Strategy \& Roadmap — Define and operationalize a 12–24 month roadmap for Data Services that supports company data and AI goals (data APIs, platform, governance, ML pipelines, model serving and monitoring).
* Team Leadership — Hire, mentor and grow a high\-performing team (data engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, SREs). Build leadership bench and establish clear career paths.
* Data Platform Ownership — Own the design, delivery, and run\-book for data platforms (data lake/warehouse, streaming, ingestion, processing, metadata/catalog, lineage and observability).
* ML/AI Enablement — Partner with AI/ML teams to build repeatable ML pipelines and production model serving (batch \& real\-time). Lead MLOps adoption: model training, deployment, CI/CD, drift detection, and model governance.
* AI Productionization — Drive production\-grade implementations of AI use\-cases (including large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, agentic/automated workflows). Ensure safe, scalable, and cost\-efficient model serving and inference.
* Data Products \& APIs — Deliver production data products and APIs consumed by analytics, product teams, and AI systems. Enable self\-service data and ML capabilities for downstream teams.
* Quality, Observability \& Governance — Implement enterprise\-grade data quality, lineage, cataloging, access controls, and privacy/compliance practices. Partner with security and legal on policy for AI model usage and data privacy.
* Stakeholder Management — Work cross\-functionally with product, engineering, marketing, sales, and COE to translate business needs into data and AI programs, prioritizing high\-impact work and measuring outcomes.
* Metrics \& Outcomes — Define and report KPIs for platform reliability, time\-to\-insight, model accuracy/performance, cost, and adoption.


**Qualifications**
* 12\+ years’ experience in data engineering, data platform, analytics, or ML engineering roles, with at least 3\+ years in a people\-/team\-management role.
* Hands\-on experience building and operating large\-scale data platforms (data lakes/warehouses, Spark/Databricks, Snowflake/Redshift/BigQuery, streaming with Kafka/Kinesis).
* Demonstrated track record of taking ML/AI projects from POC to production. Practical experience with MLOps tooling and pipelines (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or equivalent).
* Deep familiarity with model serving and inference architectures (real\-time and batch), model monitoring, automated retraining, and drift detection.
* Strong engineering skills: Python / SQL (and/or Scala/Java), data pipeline frameworks, and versioned data/model workflows.
* Experience with LLMs and modern AI application patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, LLM safety/guardrails, and LLMOps frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Cloud platform experience (AWS / Azure / GCP) and experience designing cost\-efficient, production\-grade ML inference at scale.
* Experience with data governance, cataloging (Amundsen/Atlas/Data Catalog), lineage and privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA) in a production environment.
* Excellent people and cross\-functional leadership skills, with strong communication, stakeholder influence, and program management ability.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field. Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in a quantitative or engineering discipline preferred.
